decision.rationale: The current page exposes twenty short but complementary 2009 program scope, schedule, and overview files across three presentation locations. A single organized master gives the public a coherent program record while retaining every source file, its provenance, and topical cross-listings.
decision.provenance_rule: All 24 master components remain distinct original records. The two Streets schedules are distinct City editions; source chronology is recorded without a final/adopted inference. Senior Affairs and Family and Community Services components are independently material, not Community Facilities duplicates.
decision.presentation_rule: Consolidation changes only the future Capital Spending browsing form. It does not collapse original archival records, settled duplicate relationships, or useful topical cross-listings.
